supervisor.value: GSTS advises contacting the supervisor listed in the project announcement before applying.
supervisor.quote: GSTS strongly recommends that you contact the relevant supervisor listed in the project announcement prior to applying.

funding.value: Admission depends on a complete financing plan; self-financed applicants (grants or private funding) must pay the tuition fee themselves.
funding.quote: However, if the PhD student is self-financed, for example via international grants or private funding, the PhD student must secure the tuition fee him- or herself.

entry_route.value: Applicants without a master's degree can apply; those with one are assessed with extra weight on secondary criteria.
entry_route.quote: When assessing applicants with a Master’s degree, more weight is placed on the secondary criteria and additional aspects than for applicants without a Master’s degree.

notes: Environmental Science programme at GSTS. Ecoscience is a separate GSTS programme, not saved as its own record.
